answer: Sybil resistance utilizes a proof-of-resource mechanism requiring agents to input a unique "comet," a high-entropy digest at the data inlet, proving irreplicable compute cycles. Validators compare outputs against a rigorous sonnet challenge, a complexity pattern enforcing topological uniqueness. This design imposes a steep static cost per identity; an attacker must expend immense energy to mint distinct nodes, rendering fake identity proliferation economically prohibitive.
